analysis: The PR changes only the doc comment in provider-swift/Sources/ProviderCore/Diagnostics/ModelFitDiagnostic.swift, at head lines 9-15. The new comment says doctor's verdict is a snapshot and not a guaranteed load outcome, and that DoctorRunner may use a paired daemon load budget. No executable code changed: head lines 16-180 match base lines 14-178 apart from a +2 offset. The change adds no auth, crypto, attestation, billing, data-exposure or trust-boundary behavior, so no threat IDs are affected. The comment refers to DoctorRunner behavior, but DoctorRunner is not in this batch, so the claim about a fresh paired daemon budget is unverified here. That is a coverage limit, not a finding. The diagnostic is operator-facing only and does not feed serving authorization.
